src_members.sig: public static int Mod(int a, int b)
src_members.name: Mod
src_members.comment: Proper mathematical modulo, unlike C#'s % operator, which returns negative results for negative input. Mod(-1, 5) => 4, not -1. Useful for wrapping array indices, angles, and grid coordinates.

src_members.sig: public static float Remap(float value, float inMin, float inMax, float outMin, float outMax)
src_members.name: Remap
src_members.comment: Remaps a value from one range to another, e.g. Remap(healthPercent, 0, 1, minPitch, maxPitch).

src_members.sig: public static float RemapClamped(float value, float inMin, float inMax, float outMin, float outMax)
src_members.name: RemapClamped
src_members.comment: Same as Remap but clamps the input first, avoids overshoot when value is slightly out of range.

src_members.sig: public static float DeltaAngle(float fromDegrees, float toDegrees)
src_members.name: DeltaAngle
src_members.comment: Shortest signed difference between two angles in degrees, always in [-180, 180]. Use this instead of subtracting angles directly to avoid the 359-to-1-degree wraparound bug.

src_members.name: Damp
